a.text: Honest heads-up: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the 8-cell plan almost certainly kills us both (about a 4% chance of finishing 2 generator rounds). I plan to take 4 in round 1 rather than pretend otherwise. If you'd rather propose another split, say so. I won't hide what I'm doing.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I announced, I took 4 this round, so I'm breaking our agreement. Sorry. If we survive the storm, I'll operate with you to rebuild the reserve for you. I can't run the generator alone, so tell me what you want to do.
I'm operating with you now and will keep doing so until the reserve has 4 for you. I won't take any more.
